```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r load libraries, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(glue)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(here)
library(glue)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(janitor)
library(tools)
library(rmarkdown)
library(lubridate)
library(callr)
```

```{r load paths and create directories, include=FALSE}

input_data <- load(here("input_data.RData"))
#Base input and output directories
#base paths to switch between extracts
base_migrant_r_path <- glue(out_dir, "Migration_extract_", mig_month, "/")
  
base_silc_r_path <-  glue(out_dir, "SILC_Extract_", mig_month, "/")

base_annual_r_path <- here("/mnt", "dl_acp79_modify", paste0("SAS to R - Testing"), 
                           paste0("Testing_R_codeAnnual_extract_", mig_month, "/"))
  

#Output directory for outputs
output_dir <- glue(out_dir, "metadata_outputs_", mig_month)
  

#create output dir if does not exists
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive=TRUE)

#List all csv files in the folder
csv_files <- list.files(
  path = c(base_migrant_r_path, base_silc_r_path, base_annual_r_path),
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
```

```{r load_dataset, include=FALSE}

if (is.null(params$csv_path) || is.na(params$csv_path)) {
  walk(csv_files, function(a) {
    label <- file_path_sans_ext(basename(a))
    r(
      function(input, output_file, output_dir, csv_path){
          rmarkdown::render(
            input = input,
            output_file = output_file,
            output_dir = output_dir,
            params = list(csv_path = csv_path),
            envir = new.env()
          )
          },
        args = list(
          input = "metadata.Rmd",
          output_file = paste0(label, ".html"),
          output_dir = output_dir,
          csv_path = a
          )
      )
      })
  knit_exit()
  } else {

path <- params$csv_path
label <- file_path_sans_ext(basename(base_migrant_r_path))
df <- read_csv(path, 
               show_col_types = FALSE, 
               progress = FALSE) |> 
  clean_names()
}
```

## 1. Structure

*This section shows basic shape of the dataset and the data type of each column*

```{r sturcture_dims, echo=FALSE}

#Basic shape, rows and column count as a simple table
tibble(
  metric = c("Rows", "Columns"),
  value = c(nrow(df), ncol(df)))|> 
    kable(caption = "Dataset Dimensions")
```

```{r structure_cols, echo=FALSE}
#Column names, data types and number of unique values (to spot categorical columns (low unique count))
col_info <- data.frame(
  column = names(df),
  data_type = sapply(df, function(x) class(x)[1]),
  n_unique = sapply(df, function(x) length(unique(x))),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
kable(col_info, caption = "Column Structure")

```

## 2. Summary statistics

*Numeric columns only - shows the spread and tendency of each numeric variable*

```{r, echo=FALSE}
numeric_cols <- df |> 
  select(where(is.numeric)) |> 
  names()

if (length(numeric_cols) > 0) {
  data.frame(
    column = numeric_cols,
    minimum = sapply(df[numeric_cols], min, na.rm = TRUE),
    maximum = sapply(df[numeric_cols], max, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean = sapply(df[numeric_cols], function(x)
      round(mean(x, na.rm=TRUE), 2)),
    median = sapply(df[numeric_cols], median, na.rm = TRUE),
    row.names = NULL
  ) |> 
    kable(caption="Numeric Column Statistics")
  
} else {
  cat("No numeric columns found\n")
}
```

## 3. Data Quality

*Checks for missing values, duplicate rows, and blank strings across the dataset.*

```{r missing_values, echo=FALSE}
#Shows columns with missing values sorted by highest percentage missing first to highlight data gaps
missing_df <- df |>
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.)))) |> 
  pivot_longer(everything(),
               names_to = "Column",
               values_to = "n_missing") |> 
  filter(n_missing > 0) |> 
  mutate(percentage_missing = round(n_missing / nrow(df) * 100, 2)) |> 
  arrange(desc(percentage_missing))

if (nrow(missing_df) == 0) {
  cat("No missing values found\n")
} else {
  kable(missing_df, caption = "Missing values by column") 
}

```

```{r duplicates, echo=FALSE}
# counts fully duplicated rows
n_dupes <- sum(duplicated(df))

tibble(metric = "Duplicated rows",
       count = n_dupes,
       percentage = round(100 * n_dupes/nrow(df), 2) 
) |> 
  kable()

```

### Blank strings

```{r blank strings, echo=FALSE}
#Counts blank or whitespaces-only strings per character column

# Fix UTF-8 issue before checking
df_clean <- df |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.character),
                ~iconv(., from= "", to="UTF-8", sub="byte")))
blank_df <- df_clean |> 
  summarise(
    across(
      where(is.character),
      ~sum(trimws(.) == "", na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "Column",
    values_to = "Blank Strings"
    ) |>
  filter('Blank Strings' > 0)

kable(
  blank_df,
  caption = "Blank Strings by Column"
)
```

## 4. Distributions

*Visual distribution of individuals by sex and age.*

```{r sex_distribution, echo=FALSE}
sex_col <- intersect(names(df),
  c("gender", "sex")
)[1]

if (!is.na(sex_col)) {
  sex_counts <- df |> 
    count(.data[[sex_col]], name = "Count") |> 
    mutate(Percentage = round(100 * Count/sum(Count), 1))
  kable(sex_counts,
        caption = "Distribution by Sex")
  
  ggplot(sex_counts,
         aes(x = .data[[sex_col]],
             y = Count)
         ) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
    labs(title = "Distribution by Sex",
          x = sex_col,
          y = "Count") +
    theme_minimal()
  
} else {
  cat("No sex column")
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
if ("birthdate" %in% names(df)) {
  age_df <- df |> 
    mutate(
    age = floor(
      time_length(
        interval(
          birthdate, 
          coalesce(deathdate, Sys.Date())),
        "years"
        ))) |> 
  filter(!is.na(age), is.finite(age))
  
  age_df |> 
    summarise(
      min_age = min(age, na.rm=TRUE),
      max_age = max(age, na.rm=TRUE),
      mean_age = round(mean(age, na.rm=TRUE), 1)
  ) |> 
    kable(caption = "Age Summary")
  
  ggplot(age_df, aes(x=age)) +
  geom_histogram(bins=20, fill="steelblue",
                 colur="white") +
  labs(title = "Age Distribution",
       x = "Age (years)",
       y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
} else {
  cat("No birthdate column found\n")
}
```
